description: HW5 Problem 4 smoke test. Each tool was called by the vibe coder (Claude Code) through the campus-customs MCP server registered in hw5/.mcp.json. Each output is checked against direct SQL on data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP, check stock for CC-TEE-WHITE size S for ticket 101 that needs 1 unit.

db_check.sql: SELECT * FROM inventory WHERE sku='CC-TEE-WHITE' AND size='S';
db_check.ticket_sql: SELECT sku, size, qty FROM tickets WHERE id=101;
db_check.derived: shortfall = max(0, ticket qty 1 - on-hand qty 0) = 1, so can_fill_from_stock = false

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP, get the status of invoice 501 for ticket 101.

db_check.sql: SELECT i.*, v.name AS vendor_name, v.specialty, v.lead_days FROM invoices i JOIN vendors v ON v.id=i.vendor_id WHERE i.id=501;
db_check.ticket_sql: SELECT invoice_id FROM tickets WHERE id=101;
db_check.derived: status 'open' and desk date 2026-08-31 is 3 days after due_date 2026-08-28, so overdue = true and vendor_blocked = true

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP, get the rent due for lease 1 for ticket 102.

db_check.ticket_sql: SELECT lease_id, notes FROM tickets WHERE id=102;

ticket_row.notes: Email: shop rent due in 2 days.

db_check.derived: next_due 2026-09-02 minus desk date 2026-08-31 = 2 days, so overdue = false (this matches the ticket note 'rent due in 2 days')
